name: pam_setquota
description: Set disk quotas on session login
detailed_description: Session module that automatically sets disk quotas for users when they log in. Allows administrators to configure per-user or per-range quotas for specific filesystems. Useful for automatic quota management during login sessions.

parameters.startuid: Starting UID range for quota application
parameters.enduid: Ending UID range for quota application
parameters.fs: Filesystem or mount point to apply quotas to

notes:
Automated disk quota management module; requires Linux quota subsystem support and quotas to be enabled on filesystems.
